name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the ongoing conversation and context provided.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the ability of the response to stimulate further discussion or interest from the other participant.

name: Creativity
description: Evaluates the originality and uniqueness of the response, particularly in the context of the conversation.

name: Coherence
description: Checks how logically consistent and understandable the response is within the context of the conversation.

name: Information Value
description: Measures the usefulness and informativeness of the response, particularly if it provides new insights or facts.
